name: Qantas student offer from Hong Kong
summary: 40kg baggage and a free date change on Qantas flights from Hong Kong for students enrolled full-time in Australia on a student visa.
who: Hold a valid International Student Identity Card (ISIC).
Enrolled full-time at an accredited educational institution in Australia or New Zealand.
Travelling on a valid student visa.
catches: Only Qantas-operated flights departing Hong Kong to Australia or New Zealand.
Booked through Qantas-appointed agents in Hong Kong.
Cannot be combined with other special fares.

evidence.quote: This offer is only valid for Qantas-operated flights departing from Hong Kong to Australia or New Zealand.
